meta.title: Northline Coffee — How the business stands (as of 2026-07)

views.label: What sells and who charges
views.note: Shopify owns the order and the tax it collected; Stripe owns the charge, the fee and the payout. Neither is the books.

views.label: Where cash lands
views.note: A payout is settled cash only when Chase 1002 shows it. QuickBooks recognizes revenue; the Shopify dashboard never does.

views.label: Who closes and on what rules
views.note: The controller ties payouts and the bank to zero before the period locks. The truth rules underneath decide every disagreement.

roof.label: Northline Coffee roasts and sells coffee direct to consumers and to wholesale accounts
roof.sublabel: One legal entity · accrual basis · one system of record per fact · as of 2026-07

foundation.label: Northline Coffee LLC
foundation.sublabel: One legal entity · accrual basis · no consolidation drawn

foundation.label: Truth rules
foundation.sublabel: Orders in Shopify · cash in Chase · revenue in QuickBooks, never the dashboard

cards.title: One system of record per pillar
items: Orders, customers, tax collected, gift cards: Shopify
Settled cash: Chase 1002 · Revenue, A/R, P&L: QuickBooks

cards.title: Guardrails
items: No amounts or balances: none were supplied for 2026-07
A Shopify or Stripe dashboard total is never revenue
DTC is a sales receipt; A/R exists only for wholesale invoices

cards.title: How to read it
items: Roof: the business in one sentence
Capital: system of record · shaft: facts it owns · plinth: the truth claim
Foundation: the entity and the rules that settle disagreements
